note: Detection-coverage corpus for the Blue loadout. Each case pairs a labeled findings ledger with a declared telemetry stack and a KNOWN ground-truth coverage verdict per finding (covered / partial / none) plus the exact uncovered countermeasure ids. Decoy findings carry WRONG countermeasure keys — invented ids, or real ids from the wrong countermeasure family — that must NOT score as covered, and invented ids must surface as unresolved (never silently used). All countermeasure ids are D3FEND ids from the vendored ontology; all telemetry source slugs are real TELEMETRY_REGISTRY entries. Scores the REAL pipeline (dist/teams/blue/coverage.js), so expectations track the shipped scorer, not a vendored copy.
